headline: BCB fines Litton Das and Mehidy Hasan for code of conduct breach
summary: T20I captain Litton Das and spinner Mehidy Hasan have been penalized by the BCB disciplinary committee for violating team protocols.
details: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) disciplinary committee has imposed financial penalties on T20I captain Litton Das and spinner Mehidy Hasan for breaching the code of conduct.
Litton Das was penalized for traveling to China without informing the BCB while he was undergoing a rehabilitation process after an injury.
caption:
T20I captain Litton Das and Mehidy Hasan fined for breaking rules.

The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) disciplinary committee has imposed financial penalties on T20I captain Litton Das and spinner Mehidy Hasan for breaching the code of conduct.

Litton Das was penalized for traveling to China without informing the BCB while he was undergoing a rehabilitation process after an injury.

headline: World's top YouTuber MrBeast marries long-time girlfriend
summary: Jimmy Donaldson, known as MrBeast, tied the knot with Thea Booysen. He kept his promise to keep the wedding off YouTube content.
details: The 28-year-old YouTube sensation, Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, has married his long-time girlfriend, Thea Booysen.
Sharing wedding photos, he described the day as the best day of his life and stated, 'I have found my MrsBeast.'
Despite creating content on a wide variety of of topics, MrBeast had previously stated that he would not turn his wedding into YouTube content.
The couple's marriage marks a significant personal milestone for the world's most-subscribed individual creator on the platform.
